suggestions.instruction: Add ev-011 and ev-012, drop ev-005 or reframe it. ev-005 Meta Cortechs compliance is padding for identity — it belongs to society plot. If kept, frame only as Thomas Anderson identity performance vs Neo alias, not as societal lie. Missing ev-011/012 leaves the death of Anderson unrepresented, breaking membership completeness.

suggestions.instruction: Rewrite false enablers: ev-020 does not enable ev-022. Cypher's steak bargain did not cause Neo to press Morpheus on five predecessors; ev-022 is enabled by ev-014 prophecy declaration + ev-016 failed jump. Change ev-022 caused_by to that. suggestions.plot: The Believer Who Bets Everything: Morpheus's Faith
suggestions.instruction: Drop ev-032 and ev-034 from this plot or reframe strictly as impact pressure. Both are Neo protagonist decisions/actions (choosing rescue, helicopter assault) that belong to Becoming the One and Crew plots. They do not demonstrate Morpheus's faith except as off-screen pressure. Replace with ev-010 (offering choice) and ev-013 (Desert of Real) where Morpheus actively risks crew to show truth.

suggestions.instruction: Insert ev-021 and ev-022 to fix and-then: ev-016 Trinity's quiet hope and ev-017 deflection have no enabler without the Oracle's love prophecy. ev-021 where Neo presses Trinity about what Oracle told her and ev-022 where Morpheus confesses misunderstanding are the conditions that make her guarded faith necessary. suggestions.plot: A Love That Requires Belief: Neo and Trinity
suggestions.instruction: Drop ev-032 (Neo denies One yet rescues Morpheus) — it is a Morpheus-faith/crew event, not a relationship event. Membership requires love-specific action. Add ev-021 (car ride Trinity pressed), ev-035 (Morpheus reinterprets Trinity's silence as confirmation), and ev-030 (Trinity wakes and grieves) to earn the withheld-love arc. Keep ev-038 but add ev-037 subway escape as enabler.

suggestions.instruction: Enforce perspective discipline: remove Neo-hero framing of ev-032, ev-033, ev-034, ev-045. Reframe ev-033/034 as collective extraction with Tank/Trinity roles, or drop them and keep ev-027 Regrouping, ev-030 Survivors Escape, ev-024 plumbing wall as crew survival. suggestions.instruction: Fix three and-then links: ev-019 Sentinel hunt is not enabled by ev-003 Trinity escape — enable by ship's electromagnetic wake exposure after ev-013. ev-028 Cypher reaches exit is not enabled by ev-026 gas — enable by ev-021 dropped phone in garbage + ev-027 Tank routing to Franklin/Erie. ev-045 destroying Smith is not enabled by ev-042 — enable by ev-044 Trinity kiss revival which is missing from chain.

suggestions.plot: The Crew Against the System: Surviving the Agents
suggestions.instruction: Prune padded 19-event chain: drop ev-032 (individual wager) and ev-036/040/042 redundancy (three trace/Sentinel beats). Add missing crew beats ev-027 Regrouping on Street and ev-030 Survivors Escape and Wake which actually show collective survival after betrayal. suggestions.plot: The Matrix Itself: A World Built on a Comfortable Lie
suggestions.instruction: Close arc gap between ev-020 and ev-045: add ev-023 Trap Springs (Matrix rewrites itself, repeated cat, Mouse killed in Room 1313) and ev-031 Agents double serum on Morpheus. Without them the society's self-correction and torture for Zion codes is missing, leaving truth-vs-lie with no system enforcement turn before Neo rewrites code.

suggestions.plot: The Matrix Itself: A World Built on a Comfortable Lie
suggestions.instruction: Reframe shared events with society-only lens to stop rehash: ev-005 must be framed as systemic normalization (alarm clock/Meta Cortechs/Rhineheart authority making lie invisible) not Anderson identity split; ev-045 must be framed as simulation's invincibility broken for populace (Agents feel fear, code visible) not Neo's personal One confirmation.
